description: Search clinical trials market-wide (across companies), filtered by phase, indication, sponsor, status and date window, with sorting and pagination. An unrecognised phase, status, dateField or sort value is rejected with the allowed list (it is never silently ignored). A result's ticker is the company whose trial list the row was collected under, which may be the lead sponsor or only a collaborator; metadata.sponsor is the lead sponsor, so a row is that ticker's own trial only when metadata.sponsor is that company.

dateField.description: Date column the from/to window applies to (default primary_completion_date)

from.description: Inclusive start: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

indication.description: Comma-separated condition names, exact match (case-sensitive), e.g. "Breast Cancer"

phase.description: Comma-separated phases, matching ANY of them. Allowed tokens: EARLY_PHASE1, PHASE1, PHASE2, PHASE3, PHASE4 (also accepted: "Phase 2", "2", "Early Phase 1"). Example: "PHASE2,PHASE3". A combined "Phase 2/Phase 3" string is rejected; each phase is a separate token.

sponsor.description: Case-insensitive substring of the LEAD sponsor name (collaborators are not searched)

to.description: Inclusive end: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (a partial date covers its whole year/month)

name: search_clinical_trials
title: Search Clinical Trials
